meta.title: Sprint 42 planning
meta.agenda: 1) carry-over tickets 2) release date for v3.2 3) on-call rota
meta.reference: Release v3.2 is scheduled for Friday Nov 14. Team velocity last sprint was 31 points. Capacity this sprint is 28 points because Sam is on leave Wednesday to Friday. PAY-210 (payments migration) is blocked on the vendor until Nov 3. SRCH-88 (search revamp) is estimated at 13 points. On-call: Priya this week, Dev next week.

speaker: Maya
text: Morning everyone. Sprint 42 planning, three things: carry-over, the release date, and on-call.

speaker: Maya
text: Let's start with carry-over. We have four tickets from last sprint.

speaker: Dev
text: PAY-210 is the big one. I think the vendor unblocked us yesterday, so it's basically ready.

speaker: Priya
text: Oh nice, I hadn't heard that.

speaker: Maya
text: Okay. What about the two UI bugs?

speaker: Priya
text: Both are in review, should merge today.

speaker: Maya
text: Good. And the flaky test ticket?

speaker: Dev
text: That one I'd drop. It hasn't failed in two weeks.

speaker: Maya
text: Fine by me. So, new work. Sam, how much room do we have?

speaker: Sam
text: Last sprint we did 31 points, and I'm out Wednesday to Friday, so less than that.

speaker: Maya
text: Let's say around 28 then.

speaker: Dev
text: I want to pull in the search revamp.

speaker: Priya
text: How big is that one?

speaker: Dev
text: Hmm, I don't remember. Eight? Maybe thirteen?

speaker: Maya
text: Let's assume it fits.

speaker: Sam
text: Totally unrelated, but did you all see the new one Priya bought?

speaker: Priya
text: Ha, yes, it's a split ergonomic one. Took me a week to type normally.

speaker: Dev
text: I tried one of those. My wrists loved it but my pinky didn't.

speaker: Sam
text: Which switches did you go with?

speaker: Priya
text: Brown ones. Quiet enough for calls, mostly.

speaker: Maya
text: Okay okay. Back to it.

speaker: Maya
text: Release date. When are we shipping 3.2?

speaker: Sam
text: End of the month I think, the 28th?

speaker: Dev
text: That sounds right.

speaker: Maya
text: Okay, so carry-over is sorted, search revamp is in, and let's move to on-call.

speaker: Maya
text: Who's on call this week?

speaker: Dev
text: Kuuki, who's on the rota this week?

speaker: Priya
text: And next week is Dev, right?

speaker: Dev
text: Yep, I'm next.

speaker: Maya
text: Anything else before we wrap?

speaker: Sam
text: Just a heads-up, design review moved to Thursday.

speaker: Maya
text: Thanks. Okay, that's it, see you all at standup.
